_doc: Rebuild data for YP_bouwnummer_25.pdf (Type R3.sp). Phase 1 extracted dimensions from the PDF; Phase 2 renders this to floorplan/floorplan.svg (tools/render-floorplan.py); Phase 3 builds the 3D model (APARTMENT_GEOM in index.html) and verifies it against this plan with tools/plan-overlay.py. As of the latest fidelity pass every model wall/door endpoint lies on a plan edge within 0.05 m (see phase3_model_fidelity). Structural walls are locked; remaining `uncertain` items are interior fixture/door-position details that do not affect the shell.

high_confidence_facts: Apartment east facade interior length = 13.802 m (PDF callout 13802 with vertical dim spanning the full east edge).
Top balkon E-W length = 5.709 m (PDF callout 5709, balkon area 7.60 m² → balkon depth = 1.331 m). The balkon is shared: BOTH slaapk1 AND woonkamer have sliding doors onto it (user-confirmed).
Top facade east section E-W = 4.922 m (PDF callout 4922).
Slaapkamer 1 N-S interior depth ≈ 4.000 m (PDF callout 4000), exterior-to-interior 4.201 m (PDF callout 4201). Top facade thickness ≈ 0.20 m.

Slaapkamer 1 has a STEPPED south wall (user-confirmed 'weird shape'). 3675 mm = one section's full wall-to-wall span; 1845 mm = a PARALLEL dim in a different (door-adjacent) section. These are NOT additive.

Slaapkamer 2 E-W width = 4.115 m (PDF callout 4115). Derived N-S depth = 4.593 m so 4.115 × 4.593 ≈ 18.90 m² matches label.
Badkamer (klein) is INSIDE slaapkamer 2 (en-suite), accessed via a door in slaapk2 (user-confirmed).
Slaapkamer 2 has its own door from the gang (user-confirmed).
Toilet = 0.93 × 1.785 = 1.660 m² ≈ 1.67 m² (user-confirmed). The 880 callout is NOT the toilet width; it's likely a berging/fixture dim.
Bottom balkon N-S depth = 3.600 m (PDF callout 3600). Derived E-W width = 6.675 m so 6.675 × 3.600 ≈ 24.03 m² matches label.
Badkamer (klein) likely 1.670 × 2.289 ≈ 3.823 m² (label 3.81). 2.289 not directly labeled — inferred from area.

The 'NW chamfer' is actually a multi-segment ZIGZAG with an alcove — NOT a single 45° diagonal. The 1397 mm callout labels one of the vertical segments. Exact step-by-step coordinates STILL UNCERTAIN (see uncertain[]).

The alcove is WALKABLE interior space within slaapk1 (user-confirmed). Coordinates below are best-effort ESTIMATES (user instructed 'just estimate' since only one segment, 1397, is labeled).
